game_title: Rounding Range – Lava Tube Tunnel Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel, a glowing lava tube: the volcanologist must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Rounding Range: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel: a glowing lava tube
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava Tube Tunnel, repeat each round: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots. Each round, lava imps strike the summit beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the slot_matches value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the summit beacon from lava imps in Lava Tube Tunnel: keep the slot_matches meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 34-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: slot_matches drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 34-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Rounding Range
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slot_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Lava Tube Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 34 seconds while slot_matches > 0.
